title: Beautiful Throw
text: Beautiful Throw. Its really nice and the colors are really distinct but not overwhelming.....definitely a throw so not a super big blanket but nice and soft.

product_metadata.title: Bohemia Throw Blanket Knitted Blankets with Tassels Boho Acrylic Textured Woven Throw for Sofa Couch Bed Solid Woolen Decor 50x60 inches
features: BOHO DESIGN: Geometric pattern design is the most popular element nowadays. The beige wool knit has a strong bohemian pattern. Four textured tassels give this blanket an elegant and luxurious look. Definitely a good choice for rustic home decor.

SOLID WOLEEN KNITTED: Knitted blanket made of 100% acrylic coarse wool yarn, special knitting process makes the blanket elastic. The soft fabric and warm touch are perfect for adults, women, seniors and children.

MULTI PURPOSE: It’s suitable for many conditions. When you put on this blanket, you will feel its softness and warmth, bring you comfortable and relaxed feeling. You can use it in bed, sofa, or cars. It also can be a perfect air-condition blanket.

EASY CARE: You can wash them in cold water wih washing machine. Textile products containing moisture when hanging easily deformed, it is recommended to machine wash and tumble dry on low speed, lay flat to dry.

CUTOMER SERVICE: Designing and manufacturing blanket is part of our job, we are also willing to provide high quality customer service. If you have any questions about the purchase, please feel free to contact us, and we will reply to you within 24 hours and solve your problem.
